Li-Fraumeni Syndrome (TP53) is a rare hereditary cancer predisposition syndrome.

Li Fraumeni syndrome is a rare but important disease that should be considered in the workup of young patients with multiple primary tumors, and in patients with a family history of cancer at young ages.
LFS should be suspected in patients who have a family history of early-onset cancers, especially in the presence of a germ-line p53 mutation.
